plain: A model judge rating answers from its own model family higher than equally good answers from others.
eli5: Liking your own drawing best because it looks the way you would draw it.
technical: Self-enhancement bias: an LLM judge assigns higher scores or win rates to outputs it (or its model family) generated, beyond what human raters give the same outputs (Zheng et al. 2023; Panickssery et al. 2024 tie it to the judge recognising its own text).
